title: Threshold and Fourier granularity
statement: For natural numbers $n$ and $k$ with $n>0$, form the deterministic Goldreich–Levin input with accuracy $1/(4\cdot 2^k)$ and Fourier bound $2^{k+1}$. Its threshold is at most the degree Fourier granularity $2(1/2)^{k+1}$.
